coverage: The central completes startup, service discovery, CCCD subscription and normal MIDI delivery.

The signaling tests cover identifiers, invalid commands, fragmented replies, bounds, reply priority, unavailable credits and transport refusal.
The reconnect tests restore credits only after successful disconnection. Completion counts saturate before conversion.
The abort tests distinguish submission acceptance, command status and successful Disconnection Complete.
The abort tests cover refused sends, recovery before expiry, absent completion, failed status, wrong handles, repeated stop, start and reconnect.
The deadline tests execute the production service body with simulated dependencies.
The 38 deadline cases cover overflow and timeout, direct stop, service and both successful connection event types during cancel.
The deadline cases cover expiry minus 1 ms, exact expiry, expiry plus 1 ms and timer wrap.
Normal stop starts a new interval. An active abort interval does not change. Late successful completion keeps stop intent.

diag.coverage: The Python tests check old and extended DIAG words, handles, rejected headers and unchanged peripheral decoding.
